facts.says: a test never commands the scrubber below 30 percent and never stops it
facts.reference: decided 2026-09-22 for the concentration-decay test (docs/mise-en-service.fr.md, section 9)

facts.says: a test's CO2 abort limit, and its maximum under it, stay at or below 3200 ppm, under the ELEVATED level of 3500
facts.reference: decided under the cabin's ELEVATED level, habitat.co2.elevatedPpm (station-topology)

facts.says: a test lasts 60 minutes at most
facts.reference: decided for the commissioning tests: the longest exposure one test may cause

facts.says: a test's CO2 maximum sits at least 200 ppm above the CO2 measured at its start
facts.reference: decided 2026-09-28 after a test stopped at its first minute

facts.says: a test stops when the battery falls under 35 percent, or under a higher threshold
facts.reference: the executor's battery threshold, the night's reserve for the scrubber

facts.says: the monitored band starts at 45 bpm or higher
the monitored band ends at 120 bpm or lower
